item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes an investigative board, sets its membership structure and qualifications, and reserves appointment of its members; these are internal organizational actions rather than changes to private legal rights.","evidence":"There is established, effective July 15, 1986, a board of three members to be appointed by the President to investigate the disputes."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The provision directs how the board must conduct its functions by limiting operations to available funding; it is internal administrative management and does not itself release or mandate funding.","evidence":"The board shall perform its functions subject to the availability of funds."},{"segment_id":"3","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines internal directions requiring the board to report and terminate with a presently operative legal prohibition barring carriers and employees from changing disputed conditions during the specified period.","evidence":"no change, except by agreement of the parties, shall be made by the carriers or the employees in the conditions out of which the disputes arose"}]}
